versions.text: Criterion: Verify that roll control effectiveness is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.3.5 Roll control effectiveness (see table LVIII for guidance). b. 5.2.3.5.1 Additional roll requirements for Class IV air vehicles (see tables LX, LXI and LXII for guidance). c. 5.2.3.5.2 Roll termination. d. 5.2.3.5.3 Roll control power with asymmetric loads. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
